subject: Sherpa Systems — co-sell & GCP marketplace integration kickoff
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Li <ava.li@sherpasystems.com>
Cc: partners@sherpasystems.com
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sherpa Systems — co-sell & GCP marketplace integration kickoff

Hi Ava —

Great speaking with you on Friday. Per our conversation, Sherpa’s managed data connector would be a valuable complement to Redwood Inference’s private deployment story in GCP, and there’s a clear co-sell angle for customers in analytics and regulated industries.

To move quickly, I propose a short technical kickoff + mutual action plan next week:
- Technical discovery (30m) with Redwood infra and Sherpa engineering
- SKU & metering alignment session (30m) with our marketplace ops
- Security evidence handoff (we can accept a spreadsheet + SOC2 excerpt)

I attached a high-level integration map (integration-map-v1.pdf) and a first-draft sprint plan (sherpa-gcp-sprint-plan.md) for discussion. Can you do Wed or Thu morning PT?

Outcomes I’m trying to land: agreed listing owner, clear mapping from Sherpa features to GCP SKUs, and a timeline for co-sell enablement assets (demo kit, joint one-pager). If we can lock dates this week we’ll schedule the relevant Redwood teams.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering.

Best,
Ben Carter
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0172
Redwood Inference — production LLM inference for engineering teams

Ben —

Thanks for the call and the materials. Sherpa is excited to move forward. Wed morning PT works for us (10:30 PT is ideal).

Quick answers to your asks:
- We can provide a populated security questionnaire (I attached an initial export, security-questionnaire-sherpa.xlsx).
- On SKU/metering: Sherpa plans to ship a managed connector SKU plus an hourly processing SKU for compute; we’ll need help mapping to GCP listing requirements and figuring out how Redwood wants to surface joint entitlements in co-sell motions.
- Demo kit: we have a short demo that shows a Redwood-powered inference pipeline with Sherpa ingestion — should be ready for a joint runbook by the end of the sprint.

I’m copying our marketplace lead (sales+gcp@sherpasystems.com) and partner ops so we can lock dates. See you Wed 10:30 PT.

Ava Li
Head of Partnerships, Sherpa Systems
ava.li@sherpasystems.com | +1 617-555-2134

Thanks everyone for the sync today — great alignment. Quick recap and agreed next steps (mutual action plan):

1) Week 0 (this week) — kickoff + technical discovery (30m) — DONE
2) Week 1 — SKU and metering mapping (Laura + Finance) — deliverable: SKU mapping doc and recommended billing surface for GCP listing

5) Week 4 — Internal enablement + co-sell playbook draft (Ben + Vivek)

Owner assignments:
- SKU mapping: laura_bennett
- Technical validation & auth patterns: olga_petrov
- Demo & customer-facing assets: monica_patel + Sherpa PM
- Enablement + playbook: ben_carter + vivek_kulkarni

Please comment on the HubSpot deal for DC-8342 (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DC-8342). I’ll upload the finalized sprint plan and a brief recording of today’s demo run on Drive.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get a co-sell listing live.

Cheers,
Ben
